rules: Do not maintain a second independent production copy of the QR-V public website.
Preserve qrv-node verification, issuer, security, health, readiness, CI, and live acceptance behavior during frontend changes.
Mobile and desktop must render from the same frontend source revision.
Protected API credentials and registry secrets must never be committed with site files or exposed through VITE_ variables.
Public verification behavior remains deterministic under QRVP-1 and QVS-1.0.
The public UI must not assert VERIFIED unless the canonical API returns the authoritative state.
